title: Linda Sue C NDE 413
content: I am a Diabetic. For years, I wondered why I never experienced any 'life after death experience', because I have been close to death several times. On this occasion, I dropped rapidly and my husband could not bring me back. I remember looking down at myself standing in a field of flowers. I saw myself younger. I started to pick a flower when I turned and looked up in the air and heard a voice say, 'Linda you can't stay, you have to go back'. Then I woke in my husband's arms.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes I'm a Diabetic, I had a hypoglycemia episode Life threatening event, but not clinical death My sugar was so low, it didn't even register on the meter. My husband gave me all kinds of medications to bring me back, but it didn't help.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | A landscape or city
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I looked down and saw myself in the field of flowers.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I saw myself - and I know it was very real! I even had a favorite black sweater on!
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I could hear my husband calling my name when I came back.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Just a beautiful field of blooming flowers.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Sadness, because I couldn't stay. Amazement, that I saw myself outside my body.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: No That it is God's decision when we go to Heaven.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: No I know I had to go back.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I heard God say I couldn't stay.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will I heard God say I couldn't stay. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I feel closer to God and I know there is life after death.
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I feel closer to God and I know there is life after death. After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes The more time went by, the more I remembered.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Best, I could re-live this experience and know God is there always. Sadness that I couldn't stay.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes My husband, he knew I was beyond his help, to bring me back.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: It took a couple days before I could actually remember everything.
